title: Partial with a scanned page
description: Page 2 is a scanned picture without a text layer. The engine recognised it with a model (`ocr_model`) and reports the picture on the unit; the core's byte scan sets `pdf_images`. Planned rule: `ocr_model` is in the recognition set, so extraction is partial even though the run status is ready, and the file is withheld from agents with `ocr` and `images`. Today `ocr_model` is not in the recognition set: extraction stays ready and only `images` withholds the file, which `current` shows. With the DC method value `ocr` today's rules already give partial.
